column1: # Table S11-4 | Placebo tests for the baseline PPML model (GDELT, total trade, h = 0–6)
# Notes: True coefficient from the baseline PPML regression (GDELT
Placebo type: total trade). Country label permutation: shocks randomly reshuffled across countries within the same year-month. Random normal shock: true shocks replaced by iid standard-normal draws. Time block permutation: contiguous 12-month blocks of the shock series permuted within countries. Placebo p-value = share of placebo coefficients with absolute value at least the true coefficient. 200 permutations per combination.
